propositions: Git probes in repo-isolation hooks invoke git rev-parse HEAD and git status --porcelain without subprocess timeouts, potentially keeping pytest alive indefinitely when Git blocks.
Autouse _no_repo_commits fixture and pytest_sessionfinish hook both call unguarded repo-isolation probes that can hang test teardown.
Test monkeypatches of subprocess.run module attribute contaminate autouse fixture teardown before patch restoration, causing false TimeoutExpired in the safety guard itself.
Subprocess internals may call time.sleep during Popen._wait backoff, allowing test monkeypatches of sleep to interfere with isolation probe timeout handling under high CI load.

Read-only repo-isolation probes must use a fixed 5-second timeout and explicitly surface subprocess.TimeoutExpired rather than collapsing it to None, while preserving None for ordinary OSError/SubprocessError/non-repo failures.
